prompt: How will staff handle check-in today?
promptZh: 員工今天會怎麼處理報到？

options.text: Use a laptop at the counter.
options.zh: 在櫃檯使用筆記型電腦。
options.whyZh: 技術人員說筆電可單獨顯示名單，接待人員也同意在櫃檯這麼做。

options.text: Borrow a screen and its stand.
options.zh: 借用一台螢幕及其支架。
options.whyZh: 備用螢幕須有專用支架，但支架明天才還。

options.text: Move check-in to the training room.
options.zh: 把報到地點移到訓練室。
options.whyZh: 訓練室是備用螢幕所在地，並非新報到地點。

options.text: Ask guests to come back tomorrow.
options.whyZh: 可改用筆電，沒有要延後報到。

explanationZh: 技術人員說筆電可單獨顯示名單，接待人員也同意在櫃檯這麼做。
evidence: Its stand won’t be back until tomorrow. That screen needs it. Your laptop can show the list by itself. / We’ll use that at the counter. The main display always comes back before support arrives.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Its stand won’t be back until tomorrow. That screen needs it. Your laptop can show the list by itself.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We’ll use that at the counter. The main display always comes back before support arrives.
